skill.name: Arduino
skill.description: Develop Arduino projects avoiding common wiring, power, and code pitfalls.
skill.summary: Voltage and Power Traps - 3.3V vs 5V logic mixing damages boards — ESP32 is 3.3V, Uno is 5V, level shifter required - USB provides max 500mA — not enough for motors, servos, or many LEDs - Never power motors from Arduino
